facts.fact: Sidwaya reports the EU-funded PASIU pilot (EUR 1 million) updated addressing in three Ouagadougou arrondissements and Bobo-Dioulasso, with over 93,000 doors and 16,000 streets addressed in Ouagadougou and two digital address platforms, Easy Geo and Webmapping grand Ouaga data, built.
